description:
The deployment-tunable surface of ``dataset/anonymize`` (ADR-0068/0070).

A subset of ``AnonymizeInput`` — just ``kinds``, tagged **governance** (ADR-0070):
*which* PII entity kinds must be redacted is a compliance/privacy policy, not a
per-run tuning knob. Like a gate threshold it is **env-owned and never weakenable**
by a workflow or run — a run cannot NARROW the redaction set (redact fewer kinds =
weaker privacy). The strict floor is the default ``None`` = *redact every recognized
kind* (on ``AnonymizeInput``); env config may pin an explicit subset per environment.

NOTE (the ADR-0070 clobber rule): ``kinds`` is intentionally left UNBOUND in the
``run-prep-anonymize`` operation YAML so the config layer supplies it — a baked
``$default($input.anon_kinds, …)`` binding would win over config and defeat the
governance guarantee. ``backend`` stays a plain operational input (not governed).

kinds.description: The recognizer/entity kinds that must be redacted (null = every recognized kind — the strict default). Env-owned governance: a workflow/run cannot narrow it.
kinds.title: PII kinds to redact

preset.description:
Ready-made redaction configuration.
• governed (default) — NER + regex + secrets: redacts names, locations, emails, phones, cards, and API keys. Best coverage.
• logs — regex + secrets only (no name/location redaction). Faster and lighter; use for log/trace data with no personal names.
Redaction always processes every row (it cannot sample), so mode here mainly trades coverage for speed. Env-owned (governance): a run cannot silently weaken it.
preset.title: Redaction mode

ner.description: Redact PERSON / LOCATION / ORGANIZATION detected by the language model. Turn OFF to redact only pattern-based PII (emails, phones, cards, secrets) — faster and lighter, but names and places are left in the data. Keep ON for training datasets. Env-owned (governance).
ner.title: Redact names & locations (NER)

model.description: spaCy model used to find names/locations to redact (ignored when NER is off). sm = fast, ~550 MB, small miss rate; lg = highest recall, ~1.2-1.7 GB; blank = no NER. Env-owned (governance).
model.title: Language model

n_process.description: CPU workers sharing the redaction pass. 0 = auto (all cores; ~40% faster on 2 CPUs). Set 1 for lowest RAM when the box runs other services. Capped at the core count.
n_process.title: Parallel workers

analyze_chunk.description: Rows fed to the detector at once. Larger = parallel workers stay busy; smaller = less memory. 2048 is a good default.
analyze_chunk.title: Rows per batch

backend.description: Detector engine: 'auto' (cascade when presidio installed, else regex) fits almost every case. Advanced: 'cascade', 'presidio', 'regex', 'regexset'.
backend.title: PII backend

$comment: scope: governance (ADR-0070) - env-owned; a run-supplied value is stripped (#905)
title: AnonymizeConfig
